pages.text: Your $(l)Hunter Card$() unlocks the hunter HUD and screens. New hunters get one on their first join. Use it (or press J) to open your profile.$(br2)Lost it? Craft a new one from a $(l)book$(), $(l)paper$() and an $(l)emerald$().
Place a $(l)Guild Desk$() next to an unemployed villager to make a $(l)Guild Clerk$(). Clerks sell cards for one emerald and trade guild goods.
